scope: Audit de provenance des TileSheets des 16 occurrences Destiny. Les noms source Metano des Grounds bruts et leurs alias d’inventaire Treasure sont distingués; aucun candidat n’est compté comme résolution exacte sans lien de provenance explicite.

newEraTagAudit.use: source candidate audit only; not used as the target quest

targetIndexNameCoverage.indexNodeConflictAmongTargetRefs: D09p03_Base is present in both town02 core and pack B with different node payloads.
targetIndexNameCoverage.comparisonBasis: Raw source sheet names, mapped back from Treasure inventory aliases without rewriting payloads; case-folded basename/index-name lookup only.
targetIndexNameCoverage.perOccurrenceScope: The prior index-specific subtable lists only 6 occurrences and must not be read as a complete 13-occurrence audit. The complete per-occurrence same-basename package-path audit is packagePathNameCoverageByOccurrence; package-path presence and exact payload identity remain distinct.

newEraTagAudit.interpretation: Name/index coverage proves coordinate candidates exist in this New Era package; it does not prove these are the intended TileSheet payloads for Destiny.
newEraTagAudit.treeTileEntriesScope: 244 candidate .tile paths matching, by case-folded basename, 202 missing raw Ground sheet names plus 8 generated_002 AGM2 names; not the total .tile file count of the tag tree.
newEraTagAudit.referenceNameBasis: Raw Sheet names extracted from exact source Grounds (Metano names); comparison is case-folded basename only.

candidateCounts.interpretation: Candidate coverage only; a basename/index hit does not establish the intended payload or map-to-sheet provenance.

treeInspection.use: Source candidate audit only; not used as the target quest (the declared namespace halcyon is prohibited as a target).

newEraTagAudit.packagePathCoverageBasis: Case-folded basename lookup for each raw Ground Sheet against .tile file paths in the installable package directories (town02 core and tile packs A–D); this does not establish payload identity or that a candidate is the intended version.

packagePathCoverageTotals.comparisonLimitation: Strict source comparison is limited to each occurrence’s recorded Ground-source commit tree, with raw source name and canonical inventory alias checked as basenames; it does not search all external history or infer map-to-sheet assignments.
